source.text: The kitchen tap drips even with the cartridge tightened. Measure the sink hole before ordering the replacement.
Loan request: Hill Textile Centre wants the woven screen for a separate spring display. Harbour Museum will commission its own crate.
North Gallery accepted our brass astrolabe for its winter exhibition. Start the loan paperwork and a fitted transport cradle.
Courier itinerary covers two jobs: collect the astrolabe for North Gallery and the woven screen for Hill Textile Centre. Keep separate loan references and receipts.
Hill Textile Centre confirmed the woven screen arrived with no tears. Save their unpacking photos with that loan.
Ask the courier about the wider one. The label fell off my sketch.
OCR from astrolabe cradle sketch: outer width 480 mm; North Gallery winter loan; leave finger clearance beside brass ring.

source.text: Scanned signed permission: brass astrolabe, North Gallery winter exhibition, courier collection approved subject to the cradle check.
Packing-room clip: the brass astrolabe sits securely in the revised cradle; staff rotate the closed crate before the North Gallery collection.
North Gallery's astrolabe display opened today. Their conservator asks us to retain the cradle dimensions for the return journey.
Astrolabe loan closeout: returned to Harbour Museum; the cradle prevented movement, but next time photograph the ring before sealing.
